title: exit_lever_ablation.py: emit TP calibration per arm (share of trades exiting within the m20 tp_cal tolerance band of their FINAL target) so a TP-revision confirmation grades calibration first
note: [2026-10-16 lane P1-ATM-BACKLOG-1016] TP doctrine clause 2 grades a TP revision on calibration BEFORE P&L ('P&L without prediction' fails). The m20 sweep writes tp_cal_cell/tp_cal_base per corpus row but those rows live on branch claude/m20-sweep-corpus and never reach main (why RQ-20261007-001/-003 and RQ-20261014-9807-03 were ungradable; RESEARCH-GRADE-PILE). exit_lever_ablation.py --grade replace (used by programme nodes P1-Q3-xrp-pb-tpx-confirm / P1-Q3-ada-pb-tpx-confirm / P1-Q4-xrp4h-exit-confirm) reports by_outcome only. BUILD: per arm, from the emitted trades (exit price vs the final tp in force, which the --tp-* harness paths already know), report tp_cal = share exiting within the m20 sweep's tp_cal tolerance band of the final target (the same constant, imported, not retyped) and the reach rate of the final target; add it to the replace grade's candidate block (reported, not graded, so existing units are unchanged); self-test with a planted arm. Then the P1-Q6-*-declare nodes register the calibration-first read on any CONFIRMED revision cell before a Tier-3 proposal. RERUN: python3 scripts/research/exit_lever_ablation.py --self-test | grep -i calibration.
